lucas: bringing up sandstone-13b on runtime today, want a quick kv/rope smoke and quant QAs. spawning thread for checklist and urgent gotchas

marta: noted. I'll run the rotary/KV alignment tests and basic perplexity suite. targeting q8 and q4

ana: can we try per-layer q8 + group-wise q2 for the tail? saw regressions on similar models

jake: timeline? if we hit regressions i'd like latency + token-cost numbers for hosted and dedicated

lucas: aim to have initial smoke in 2 hours. will drop test prompts and perf harness link

sophia: dropping a repro snippet for the kv oscillation we've seen (minimal)

```bash
# run kv-smoke harness
python tools/kv_probe.py --model sandbox/sandstone-13b --rope-mode rotary --seq-len 2048 --quant q8
```

sophia: note: check `attn_rotary_cosine` vs `rotary_complex` flags; mismatch gives phase drift after ~1k tokens

marta: I'll record embeddings drift metric + kv eviction traces. adding `--trace-kv=true` to harness

deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime/qa-job-1856123456 started by lucas :rocket:

ana: also try prompt set with long prefix (1-2k tokens) to stress kv spill and eviction heuristics

jake: add perf targets: p95 < 120ms single-token on ded instances, cost delta vs baseline < 15%

lucas: assigning owners: @marta kv/rope tests, @ana quant/quality combos, @jake perf/metrics, @sophia engineering repro

marta: uploading initial logs to the thread once ready

lucas: thanks all. if we see RoPE phase mismatch -> try `rope_scale=1.0` fallback and re-run. keep thread updated :thumbsup:
